title: 第十七章 食堂门口的重逢第十八章 陆原我们合好吧
content_zh:
从米其林回来，张遐回了宿舍，陆原则一个人在学校的树林里坐着。
今天可以说是陆原第一次真正意义上的装逼，他觉得很爽，尤其是自己和张遐坐在vip座位上的时候，陆原其实察觉到李梦瑶的目光一直投过来，那目光很复杂，陆原感觉到，目光里有很多别的情绪。
呵呵，今天还只是开胃菜，李梦瑶，你慢慢等着看清楚了。
而李梦瑶，此时也回了宿舍。
她的心里很郁闷。
不过，今天最郁闷的人，恐怕还不是她，而是杜亮。
本来，杜亮今天的计划很完美，买了车之后接李梦瑶去吃米其林，然后在这奢华又浪漫的气息里，再带着李梦瑶去开房。
谁知道，中途却出了这么一个变故。
李梦瑶吃米其林，不但没吃的开开心心，反而吃了一肚子气。
这不，杜亮也不敢再提开房的事情，最后只能送李梦瑶回了学校。
李梦瑶回到宿舍，第一件事就是去找张遐。
李梦瑶和张遐不是一个寝室的，磨磨蹭蹭到了张遐寝室门口。
自从上一次在教室里，因为陆原的事情，李梦瑶和张遐有点闹崩了，自从那以后，两人都没有再说过话。
此时，张遐回到寝室，“姐妹们，快来啊，给你们带夜宵了！”
张遐手里拎着的是从米其林打包的美食。
陆原点的菜太多了，到最后张遐和陆原两个人根本吃不完，很多菜，甚至都没有动一下，张遐觉得就这么扔下的话，很可惜。
毕竟这里面随便一道菜，都是两百块钱以上的。
于是就打包回来，带给寝室的姐妹们吃。
“哇，米其林哎，张遐，爱死你了！”
室友们都是一群吃货，饿狼扑食一样就扑了上来，看到是米其林，眼睛都绿了。

“张遐。”
李梦瑶厚着脸，站在门口喊了一声。
“对了，李梦瑶，你刚才在班级群里也发了你在米其林的照片，张遐也从米其林回来，你们两人不会一起去吃的吧？”有人问道。
李梦瑶顿时脸上一红，心里有点紧张。
她很担心张遐会把米其林的事情讲出来，如果那样的话，自己丢人就丢大了。
不过所幸，张遐不是那种小气的人，只点点头就敷衍过去了。
“你找我？”张遐虽然以前和李梦瑶是好朋友，但是现在，两人关系很僵了，所以张遐的语气也有点生硬。
“是啊，你出来一下，我想问你一个事。”
李梦瑶悄悄的说道。
“有啥事就在这里说。”张遐说道。
“哎呀，别这样，你出来嘛，咱们可是闺蜜呢。”李梦瑶挤出讨好的笑容，晃了晃张遐的胳膊，不得不说，李梦瑶也算是人才，之前还和张遐闹翻，现在瞬间就换上笑脸。
content_en:
After returning from Michelin, Zhang Xia returned to his dormitory, while Lu Principle sat alone in the woods of the school.
Today can be said to be Lu Yuan's first time to show off in a real sense. He felt very happy, especially when he and Zhang Xia were sitting in the VIP seats. Lu Yuan actually noticed that Li Mengyao's eyes kept looking at him. The eyes were very complicated. Lu Yuan felt that there were many other emotions in his eyes.
Haha, today is just an appetizer, Li Mengyao, wait and see.
Li Mengyao also returned to the dormitory at this time.
She felt very depressed.
However, the most depressed person today is probably not her, but Du Liang.
Originally, Du Liang's plan today was perfect. After buying a car, he would pick up Li Mengyao to eat at Michelin, and then take Li Mengyao to check out a hotel room in this luxurious and romantic atmosphere.
Who knew, something like this would happen midway.
When Li Mengyao ate at Michelin, not only did she not feel happy, but she also felt angry.
No, Du Liang didn't dare to mention the matter of renting a room again, so in the end he had no choice but to send Li Mengyao back to school.
When Li Mengyao returned to the dormitory, the first thing she did was to find Zhang Xia.
Li Mengyao and Zhang Xia were not in the same dormitory, so they walked slowly to the door of Zhang Xia's dormitory.
Since the last time they were in the classroom, Li Mengyao and Zhang Xia had a bit of a falling out because of Lu Yuan's incident. Since then, the two of them have not spoken again.
At this time, Zhang Xia returned to the dormitory, "Sisters, come quickly, I'll bring you supper!"
What Zhang Xia was carrying was delicious food packaged from Michelin.
Lu Yuan ordered too many dishes. In the end, Zhang Xia and Lu Yuan couldn't finish them. Many dishes were not even touched. Zhang Xia felt that it would be a pity to just throw them away.
After all, any dish here costs more than two hundred yuan.
So I packed it back and brought it to the sisters in the dormitory to eat.
"Wow, Michelin, Zhang Xia, I love you so much!"
The roommates are all a bunch of foodies, and they pounced on them like hungry wolves. When they saw it was Michelin, their eyes turned green.
"Zhang Xia."
Li Mengyao shamelessly stood at the door and shouted.
"By the way, Li Mengyao, you just posted a photo of yourself at Michelin in the class group. Zhang Xia also came back from Michelin. You two won't go to eat together, right?" someone asked.
Li Mengyao's face suddenly turned red and she felt a little nervous.
She was worried that Zhang Xia would tell the story about Michelin. If that happened, she would be embarrassed.
Fortunately, Zhang Xia was not a stingy person, so he just nodded and got over it.
"Are you looking for me?" Although Zhang Xia and Li Mengyao were good friends before, their relationship is now very tense, so Zhang Xia's tone is a bit stiff.
"Yes, come out for a moment. I want to ask you something."
Li Mengyao said quietly.
"If you have anything to say, just say it here." Zhang Xia said.
"Oh, don't be like this, come out. We are best friends." Li Mengyao squeezed out a flattering smile and shook Zhang Xia's arm. I have to say that Li Mengyao is also a talent. She had a falling out with Zhang Xia before, but now she instantly puts on a smile.
